title: RoadSport Wirebead Road Tire
notes: Official US page read 2026-11-01: US$34.99; wire bead; bead-to-bead flat protection; 700x24mm 100-125 psi about 335 g; 26mm 360 g; 28mm 85-95 psi 420 g; 30mm 440 g; 32mm 460 g; 35mm 50-80 psi 490 g. A Reflect version (32 and 35 mm, US$44.99) and an older RoadSport listing (60 TPI, same weights, US$19.99 down from US$34.99) are also sold.
